Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.ops

package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.ops
Petstore console operations pages: background jobs and the audit log.
Example:

@Rest(path="/ops", children={JobsRest.class}) public class OpsRest extends PetstoreConsolePage {}
